title: Things Fall Apart
producer: The Grand Wizzards, with James Poyser, J Dilla, Kamal Gray, Questlove and others
studio_context: Electric Lady Studios and the Cutting Room, New York, 1997-1998, alongside the Soulquarians' other sessions.

drum_performances.name: Questlove
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The Roots' breakthrough, made beside Voodoo and Like Water for Chocolate at Electric Lady, as Dilla's off-grid placement entered his playing. 'You Got Me' won the 2000 Grammy for Best Rap Performance by a Duo or Group; its outro breaks into a frenzy of sixteenths on snare and kick.

notable_moments.description: 'You Got Me': sixteenths on the hat, the kick moving about the bar under a plain 2 and 4.
'You Got Me', the outro: the groove breaks into a run of sixteenths split between snare and kick under the hat (tab bars 73-91).
